cr_data.provenance:
The artist; from whom acquired by The Downtown Gallery, New York; Collection Walker Art Center, Minneapolis, Gift of the T.B. Walker Foundation, 1954. 
(Source: Walker Art Center, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: label, 'Lake George Barn' 1926 [not verified]. Two large grey barns, end of small red building left." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work as 1927, the Walker Art Center lists date as 1926. Walker Art Center indicates that signed artwork information documentation provided by Georgia O’Keeffe indicates that the painting was produced in 1926. In a letter addressed to Lynda Hartman, O’Keeffe wrote that Lake George Barns was painted either in 1925 or 1926, but that her records indicate that the work was produced in 1926. (Source: information provided to Access O'Keeffe from the Walker Art Center, 2025)

description: Two large gray barns dominate the canvas. A smaller, dark red barn is visible on the lower lefthand side of the image. The buildings are situated on uneven, grayish green earth. The sky above is clouded over.
title: Lake George Barns
